evidence_class: independent observation: read-only native GitHub platform records; source_review for diagnosis and maintained-command selection; structural validation for hashes and recounts
kind_basis: Follows the existing github-ci-measurements-20261003 artifact_measurement receipt, with retained projected returned stdout instead of summary-only counts.
claim: A resumable CI state observation at base/main 4c897418: 8022 distinct workflow runs in 11 bounded partitions, 1430 main-cohort runs, 21 historical main failures, five main cancellations, seven effective required contexts, and explicit open ownership.
scope: Public repository GitHub CI measurement and handoff only; no settings mutation, workflow rerun, merge, installation or new test runner.

api.version: 2022-11-28 documented default; no version header passed

registration: Registered as hashed files[] evidence, matching the prior CI measurement convention; not bound to a component adoption or convergence experiment.

sources.purpose: Installed gh release verified through native --version and release GET.
Explicit GET and supported field/projection/pagination flags; lines 260–267 reject --slurp with --jq.
Created partitions below filtered 1000-result cap; per-page totals counted once.
Effective active required rules including inherited rules.
Required context freshness, missing versus skipped checks, and PR head/test-merge distinction.
Default pending replacement distinguished from executing-job cancellation.
Repository artifact_measurement receipt convention and prior durability limitations.

limitations: Pre-publication native GETs record #714 merged at 04:32:03Z and main at f946c6d4ca988a17b6fa4392ecb488909f147883: 16 successful, two skipped and five in-progress checks. Earlier passing main observations apply to 4c897418fe35a030a1188ae447eaf31c893f8eff. Follow-up reads do not alter the census creation window.

Decoded publication review uses scripts/validate.py PRIVATE_CONTENT patterns. UUID matches are public Socket SBOM details_url identifiers and StepSecurity job-correlation IDs from public check/log records, not host session identifiers; no other decoded private-content patterns matched.
Creation window is 2026-09-28T00:00:00Z through 2026-10-05T03:59:59Z inclusive (seven days plus four hours); conclusions were read over 04:09–04:26Z, not at one atomic instant.
Run-level latest outcomes only: 28 runs have run_attempt > 1; earlier attempts were not reconstructed. No flake rate or first-attempt success rate is inferred.
main cohort means head_branch == main; it includes dynamic/scheduled runs. All 21 failed and 5 cancelled main-cohort runs are push events. PR and other event cohorts remain distinct.

Elapsed workflow timestamps include scheduling/dependency intervals and are not billable or CPU minutes. Successful, failed and cancelled duration populations are separate; unfinished runs are excluded.

Projected native stdout is retained gzip-base64 with decoded stdout hashes, exact argument vectors, times and exits. Actors, authors/messages and associated PR metadata are omitted. Installed executable path is redacted as <installed-gh-2.102.0> after a transient PATH lookup failure.

Full logs and archives are withheld; numbered sanitized trace excerpts and original-byte hashes are retained. Excerpts are selective and can be truncated; they cannot reconstruct the entire raw log or archive.
Current PR check snapshots are observations of the captured head SHAs, not atomic repository readiness or merge authorization; duplicate contexts are retained. Failed read recoveries occurred later.
Latest main workflow success does not prove that all PR-only required checks passed on main or that unresolved intermittent failures are repaired.

MacOS advisory reconciliation (#711), strict up-to-date proposal (#708), PR metadata split (#706), and dependency bump (#690) remain owned open work. No branch protection/settings, workflows or owner paths changed in this lane.
Collection and review provider usage is unknown; no model execution, upstream test acceptance, efficiency gain, or live provider/GPU qualification is claimed.
